title: Capacity, Coordination & Load Dimensions
objective: Deliver a bounded read-only, profile/context-driven projection for coordination span, communication burden, administrative load, dependency, autonomy, geographic spread and organizational complexity over explicit visible owner evidence without a universal cap, single organization score, automatic growth failure or owner mutation.

governed_contract.observation_rule: ODL-02 accepts only explicit owner-referenced qualitative observations carrying profile, context, provenance and visibility references. It does not infer bands from member counts, titles, money, locations, wall-clock time or other raw owner state.
governed_contract.resolution_rule: After visibility filtering, a dimension is resolved only when its visible observed evidence agrees on one qualitative band under one profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown evidence remains unknown; incompatible-only evidence remains incompatible; divergent bands, profiles, contexts or observed/incompatible combinations remain conflict. ODL-02 never auto-resolves canonical-owner contradictions.
governed_contract.profile_context_rule: Band meaning is profile/context scoped. Bands are labels, not universal thresholds, and observations from different profile/context tuples are never collapsed into one universal score.
governed_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized organization, faction, relationship, dependency, resource, location, profile and context observations are removed before dimension state, counts, summaries, search, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden cardinality is not disclosed.
governed_contract.growth_rule: Growth or a high/heavy/wide/dispersed/complex band is descriptive pressure evidence only and never an automatic failure, command restriction, permission change or owner-domain mutation.
governed_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-02 persistence; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
governed_contract.ui: One accessible read-only panel with nonvisual dimension, profile/context, provenance, unknown/conflict and authority-boundary explanations.
governed_contract.validation: Exactly one ODL-02 current-family profile; genuine RED before production; final exact-head self-hosted Linux and Windows plus deterministic comparator; zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01 remains completed_verified and read-only owner taxonomy authority is not reopened.
Canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, Economy, Base/Vehicle, Project, DPL, WCI and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.
No universal follower or organization-size cap, single organization score, universal numeric threshold/formula or automatic growth-failure threshold is introduced.
No organizational title, rank, membership, hierarchy, dimension band or pressure label grants system permission, action authority or autonomous command authority.
No organization, relationship, resource, Character, economy, base/vehicle, Project or permission owner state is mutated; campaign time does not advance.
No duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022.
ODL-03+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
